facts.fact: The Rwanda Revenue Authority page says individual enterprises and companies are registered online through the Rwanda Development Board portal, immediately and free of charge.
The Rwanda Revenue Authority says the RDB and RRA systems are integrated so registration gives a single, unique Taxpayer Identification Number.

systems.owner: Office of the Registrar General, Rwanda Development Board

facts.fact: The Rwanda Revenue Authority says RRA registers and issues a TIN at all its offices and headquarters to individuals, NGOs, joint ventures, successions and public institutions.
The Rwanda Revenue Authority says business registration through the RDB portal, integrated with RRA systems, provides a single unique TIN.
